declarations.description:
Compact pill for a filter, a choice or an entered value: the chip of Material, Mantine and antd. A plain chip is a
read-only label. `selectable` turns it into a toggle button (`aria-pressed`) that flips `selected` on click, Enter
or Space and fires `change`, with a check mark while selected. `removable` adds a remove button that fires
`remove`; Backspace or Delete on a selectable chip does the same. The chip never removes itself: the application
drops it from its own list in the `remove` handler, so framework-rendered lists stay in sync. `c2-badge` stays the
non-interactive status label; use a chip when people pick or dismiss it.

cssParts.name: remove-button

slots.description: Icon or avatar shown before the label.
slots.name: prefix

slots.name: selected-icon

members.name: selectable
members.description: Makes the chip a toggle button that flips `selected` and fires `change`.

members.name: selected
members.description: Selected state of a selectable chip. Ignored by a plain chip.

members.name: removable
members.description: Adds a remove button. Its click, or Backspace/Delete on a selectable chip, fires `remove`.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables toggling and removal, and dims the chip.

members.name: value
members.description: Stable identity of the chip, handed back in the `remove` event. Defaults to the chip's text.

members.name: removeLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the remove button, followed by the chip's text: `Remove Design`.

members.name: readText
members.description: The text of the default slot only: an icon's text in a named slot is not part of the label.

events.name: remove
events.description: The remove button, Backspace or Delete was used. `detail.value` is the chip's `value` (or its text). Remove the chip in the handler.
A selectable chip was toggled by the user. Read `selected` on the target.
